portada.titol: Let's look at the Horta up close
portada.intro: is an open inventory of the Horta de València: what is grown, what is built and what threatens it, partida by partida.
portada.previsio: Map preview with partides and features

revisio.titol: The Horta has changed. Shall we look again?
revisio.text: Between 2017 and 2018, 80 sponsors inventoried {{n}} features. It is the starting point, not today's picture: every partida needs to be reviewed again, and every change we find is new data.

funciona.intro: Anyone can contribute. The sponsors of each partida validate, and the result belongs to everyone.
funciona.observaText: Walk the Horta and record what you see: an uncultivated plot, a farmhouse, illegal dumping. The app works without signal.
funciona.validaText: Whoever sponsors a partida reviews what is contributed there. Nobody validates their own observations.
funciona.comparteixText: Everything validated is open data under a CC BY 4.0 licence: download it by municipality and theme.

abansAra.text: Pick a date and see what has been lost. 18 orthophotos, from the 1956 flight to the latest PNOA imagery, for any point of the Horta.

apadrina.text: Choose a partida you know, follow it and validate what is contributed there. Sign in with your email and the coordinators will assign it to you.

fulls.nota: Field sheet: a blank worksheet with the partida as large as it fits and the SIGPAC plots, to note down what you find. Review sheet: the features already inventoried, numbered, with a grid, enlarged details if needed and the list to tick what is unchanged and what has changed.
